walkability.routeNote: Headless playtest (drowned-gallery-traversal.test.ts) walks squeeze → descent → hub → all three bells → shaft bottom, then apron → ring → Fire door.

openQuestionResolutions.q1_bellsToShaftTopology: RESOLVED per the 2026-08-09 one-dive amendment plus this sub-call: ONE shared column entered from the HUB's fifth opening (drowned passage under the north door). Every bell reaches the shaft through the hub after any single dive, so one dive completes the route and nothing is gated. Per-bell feeder columns were rejected because the spec pins the gravity seam to 'one bounded column with one entrance and one exit', and three feeders braid the map against 'legibility over maze'.
openQuestionResolutions.q2_ringStaging: PROPOSED: after the dives, the finale restages A/B/C on the three kept ring niches (old shore alcoves) so the mirror pool doubles them from the apron/procession. Performer ANCHORS live in the bells; the restaging mechanism is Gate 2+ runtime work. Needs Austen's call.
openQuestionResolutions.q3_footprint: SETTLED: cave-water-gallery grows from 13.5 × 24 m to 30 × 30 m interior (minInterior 18×32 → 40×40). Every room the layout engine places after it moved (Earth south door shifted +2.5 m; earth-canyon Blender manifest regenerated; earth-long-terrace pinned span updated). Downstream grayboxes built from pre-move manifests need re-verification at their own gates.
openQuestionResolutions.q4_shaftFallIn: RECOMMENDED: safe-and-floaty. The rim is a rendered curb, not a blocker; falling in lands in deep water and the Gate 2 gravity seam floats the player back up.

routeStops.sees: The ramp wades below the waterline
routeStops.title: Flooded approach
routeStops.understands: This room is entered by descending

routeStops.sees: Rock closes overhead; no air anywhere
routeStops.title: Descent
routeStops.understands: Pressure — the water owns this space

routeStops.does: Picks ONE channel — any of the three
routeStops.sees: One shaft of light overhead; three glowing mouths, the return, and a cool fifth opening
routeStops.title: Drowned hub — THE choice
routeStops.understands: Which letter becomes your personal introduction to Water

routeStops.does: Dives the one they picked (drawn at B; A and C are the same beat)
routeStops.sees: A dark channel, that letter's firelight carried through the water
routeStops.title: The chosen mouth
routeStops.understands: One dive is the route; glow and length are character, not rank

routeStops.does: Watches their letter alone, then dives back to the hub
routeStops.sees: Surface breaks on the stair; one performer at 3.0 m under a 3 m ceiling
routeStops.title: Your air-bell

routeStops.does: May dive them — or not; nothing gates the way onward
routeStops.sees: The other two mouths, still glowing, still open
routeStops.title: Optional dives
routeStops.understands: The room asked for one choice, not a checklist

routeStops.sees: The fifth opening glowing cool, not warm
routeStops.title: Shaft passage
routeStops.understands: This is the way onward, open after any single dive

routeStops.does: Jumps in and floats up (Gate 2 gravity seam)
routeStops.sees: A glowing water column rising 4.2 m
routeStops.title: Buoyant shaft

routeStops.does: Surfaces over the rim onto the apron
routeStops.sees: The dome, mirror pool, waterfall, doubled firelight
routeStops.title: Grotto ring apron
routeStops.understands: Reflection — the room shows everything twice

routeStops.does: Walks the ring past the doubled frame
routeStops.sees: All three niches doubled in the black pool (finale restaging, Q2)
routeStops.title: Procession
routeStops.understands: A, B, C together at last — including the two not dived

routeStops.sees: The carved gold-barred frame to Fire
routeStops.title: Gilded threshold
routeStops.understands: Water is complete after one dive; Fire is next
